audience: support teams with API access on a Desk365 Standard, Plus or Premium helpdesk

useCases.title: Review urgent or unassigned tickets
useCases.text: Filter tickets by status, priority and assignee, then inspect a selected ticket’s details.

useCases.title: Read a ticket’s conversation
useCases.text: Read the ticket and its conversation, including customer and agent messages, private notes and attachment details.

useCases.title: Look up a customer’s company
useCases.text: Find a contact by email and inspect its linked company and support settings.

useCases.title: Review logged support time
useCases.text: Filter time entries by ticket, agent, company or date range and inspect an individual entry.

useCases.title: Find a knowledge-base article
useCases.text: List live article titles and read a selected article’s content, category and folder.
